
[red bold]-- SYNTAX ERROR -- continue_outside_loop.volt:0[/red bold]

`continue` can only be used inside a loop (while, for, loop).


[cyan]Hint: Move this into a loop block.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- continue_outside_loop.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]
